# waroom_service_label (Data Source)

Waroom service label data source



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Label name.
- `service_name` (String) The name of the service to which the label belongs.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Label color in hex format(without#).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp
- `updated_at` (String)
- `uuid` (String) Label UUID.
